preconditions.description: The polynomial must be a string.
The point x must be an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789+-^x' for c in polynomial)
preconditions.description: The polynomial string must only contain valid characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the result.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(coeff * exp * x ** (exp - 1) for coeff, exp in terms)
postconditions.description: The result must be the sum of the differentiated terms evaluated at x.
